questions.q: To which great city was Jonah sent?
questions.evidence: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me

questions.q: How long was Jonah in the belly of the fish?
questions.evidence: Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights

questions.q: In how many days did Jonah cry that Nineveh would be overthrown?
questions.evidence: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown

questions.q: What did God make grow up to shade Jonah's head?
questions.evidence: Yahweh God prepared a vine, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head, to deliver him from his discomfort
